from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyNonCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """Non-current assets total reported by one company in their Q1 2024 financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if provided in document")
    non_current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="Total non-current assets amount as reported (in RMB Yuan)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1' or '截至2024年3月31日'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt from the document containing this value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_non_current_assets: list[CompanyNonCurrentAssets]
